visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short brown hair and glasses, wearing a cream-colored sweater, sits in a well-lit office or clinic setting. She gestures with her right hand while speaking directly to the camera. Behind her is a white vertical-slatted wall with a small gold award visible. (2) The screen switches to multiple extreme close-up photos of human lips with cracked, yellowish crusting at the corners. Red arrows and circle overlays point specifically to the sores. The woman's face is shown in a small circular inset at the bottom. (3) A fast-paced montage begins on a solid pink background. The woman, now in a white lab coat over a grey dress, performs repetitive dance movements. Multiple instances of her appear on screen simultaneously, rotating and sliding into the frame. Large stylized text overlays flash rhythmically. (4) The woman is back in the clinic setting. She holds a small white circular tub of lip balm or ointment, unscrewing the lid and demonstrating how to apply it to the corners of her mouth with her finger. Her movements are deliberate and illustrative. (5) More close-up lip photos are displayed. Cartoon-style graphics of colorful, angry-looking bacteria microbes with faces float across the screen, appearing to crawl over the images of the lips. (6) A series of text-heavy slides appear over a blurred background of the clinic. The woman continues to speak, sometimes visible at the bottom of the screen gesturing toward the text points. (7) The video concludes with the pink background dance sequence repeating, followed by a final static slide containing the clinic's logo, social media handles, and contact phone numbers.
